title: Structured Web Data Extraction (SWDE)
citation: Qiang Hao, Rui Cai, Yanwei Pang, and Lei Zhang. From One Tree to a Forest: a Unified Solution for Structured Web Data Extraction. SIGIR 2011, pp. 775-784.
original_status: unreachable (CodePlex shut down; archive blob host does not resolve)

layout.page_key: page file stem, e.g. 0001 (= ground-truth page id)

notes: Original host (CodePlex) unreachable; archives fetched from the GitHub mirror of the CodePlex project export at the pinned commit and verified against its git tree.
Pages are UTF-8 with a BOM; many still declare <meta charset=iso-8859-1|windows-1252> from the original crawl. The BOM is authoritative.
Every page starts with <base href="<source URL>"/>; source URLs are unique within each site and are used as page URLs in the generated urls.tsv (indexed under data/swde/urls/).
Ground-truth files are UTF-8 with a BOM and CRLF line ends; values keep HTML entities as in the page source ( , &, –, ...); the adapter decodes them with html.unescape.
No byte-identical duplicate pages and no missing pages: every site has pages 0000..n-1 and every ground-truth file covers exactly those ids.
